claim: By default, Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling replaces up to 10 percent of the group's desired capacity at a time until all unhealthy instances are replaced; in a group so small that 10 percent is less than one instance it replaces them one at a time, and an instance maintenance policy can modify the 10 percent value.

qualifiers.condition: groups where 10 percent of desired capacity is at least one instance; no instance maintenance policy changes the rate

evidence.quote: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling only replaces up to 10 percent of the group's desired capacity at a time. It does this until all of the unhealthy instances are replaced.
evidence.title: About the health checks for your Auto Scaling group
About the health checks for your Auto Scaling group
evidence.quote: If the size of an Auto Scaling group is small enough that the resulting value of 10 percent is less than one, Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling instead replaces the unhealthy instances one at a time.

evidence.title: About the health checks for your Auto Scaling group
evidence.quote: You can modify the default 10 percent value by [setting an instance maintenance policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/set-instance-maintenance-policy-on-group.html) to change the rate at which Auto Scaling replaces unhealthy instances.
